going_concern.quote: As a result of these uncertainties, there is substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern

financing_terms.equity_line: In February 2025, the Company entered into a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement pursuant to which the Company has the right, but not the obligation, to sell up to $20.0 million of the Company’s common stock during a 36-month period, subject to the restrictions and satisfaction of the conditions in the Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (the “SEPA”).
